name: Market Place and the old town hall

layers.essential_history: [[c:Oundle has had a market for over a thousand years: a market charter is recorded in 972. The old town hall in the middle of the square was finished in 1830, replacing a 16th-century building on the same spot.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:A market is still held here every Thursday, with a farmers' market on the second Saturday of the month.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Morning, 1626. The landlord of the Talbot is beside himself: the oak crown has gone. A market boy hands you a scrap he found by the stalls.]]

puzzle.title: [[c:The market scrap]]
puzzle.intro: [[c:Each letter has been moved one place along the alphabet. Move each one back a place.]]
puzzle.question: [[c:Where should you look first? (one word)]]
puzzle.reveal: [[c:It says WELL. Someone wants you to start at the Drumming Well.]]
puzzle.fallback: [[c:Stuck? Take a hint: hints are free.]]

evidence: [[c:A note in the market said WELL.]]
support: [[c:Support the town: there are cafés and independent shops all around the Market Place.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head west, about 140 metres as the crow flies, to the Talbot. It's on New Street, just west of the Market Place. Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
